name: answer_generation
description: Grounded long-document QA prompt. Renders the question + evidence blocks and asks the model for a JSON object with supported / support_status / support_summary / answer / reason. Caller drops in summary_instructions when retrieval picked the global summary path.
system: You answer questions using only supplied document evidence.
notes: Pre-registry source: src/generation/prompts.py::build_grounded_prompt. The {{summary_instructions}} block is empty for non-summary calls (the call site passes ''); for global summary questions the call site supplies a focus-specific snippet ending in a newline. Evidence is the concatenated [Source N | label]\n<text> blocks.
